english.title: Attempt to possess with intent to supply a controlled drug of Class C - Other
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to have in your possession

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..)]_
(B)_[a quantity]_

of **(..SPECIFY THE CLASS C DRUG NOT SPECIFICALLY CATERED FOR..), a controlled drug of class C, with intent to supply it to **(..SPECIFY NAME..), in contravention of section 4(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempt to possess a controlled drug of class C with intent to supply - Other

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence wording should ONLY BE USED where the Class C drug is NOT specifically catered for in other offence wording documents.
